services.desc: Bring your birthday plans to our Lorton school. A Taekwondo party starts with the guest of honor, a date, and a group of friends. Let the school know who is coming, including children who have not tried martial arts before. Review the activities, supplies, and any food arrangements together. services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: Dynamic Kick’s A+ After School program in Lansdowne brings school pickup, homework time, and Taekwondo into the afternoon. Start by checking whether your child’s school is on the current pickup route and which days have space. Pickup coverage is the first thing to check. Give the team your child’s school name, grade, and the days you need before making enrollment arrangements. Homework time is part of the afternoon. Talk through what your child usually brings home and how that time works at the school; completed homework is not something to assume. Taekwondo adds physical practice to the hours after school. services.name: Kids Taekwondo
services.desc: Dynamic Kick teaches Taekwondo for adults at five schools: Gainesville, Fair Lakes, Lansdowne, Lorton and Kings Park West. Classes are open to complete beginners, people returning after years away, and parents who want to train alongside their children. The first class is free. No previous martial arts experience is needed. The first weeks cover stances, basic kicks, blocks and the class routine, at a pace set for the people in the room. If you trained as a child or earned a belt years ago, tell the instructor your previous style and rank, and the school will discuss where it makes sense to start again.
